<module id="fsm">
    <description>Detection circuit for a single-bit input IN using a Mealy FSM. Outputs MATCH when the input sequence matches the pattern 10011.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="IN">Input signal to be detected.</input>
        <input id="CLK">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="RST">Reset signal to initialize the FSM.</input>
        <output id="MATCH">Output signal indicating a match condition based on the FSM state.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="S0">Initial state.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S1">State after detecting '1'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S2">State after detecting '10'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S3">State after detecting '100'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S4">State after detecting '1001'.</parameter>
        <parameter id="S5">State after detecting '10011'.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="current_state" width_description="[2:0]">Register to store the current state of the FSM.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state" width_description="[2:0]">Register to store the next state of the FSM.</reg>
        <always @(posedge CLK or posedge RST)>
            if (RST) begin
                current_state <= S0;
            end else begin
                current_state <= next_state;
            end
        </always>
    </logic_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="MATCH">Output signal indicating a match condition based on the FSM state.</assign>
        <always @(*) begin
            case(current_state)
                S0: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S1;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S0;
                    end
                end
                S1: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = S2;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S1;
                    end
                end
                S2: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b0) begin
                        next_state = S3;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S1;
                    end
                end
                S3: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S4;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S0;
                    end
                end
                S4: begin
                    if(IN == 1'b1) begin
                        next_state = S5;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = S0;
                    end
                end
                default: begin
                    next_state = S0;
                end
            endcase
        end
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Sequential logic block triggered on changes in IN, CLK, or RST
        always @(IN or CLK or RST) begin
            // Check if RST is asserted
            if(RST) begin
                // Set MATCH to 0 when RST is active
                MATCH <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                // Update MATCH based on the current state
                case(current_state)
                    S0: begin
                        // No action needed in state S0
                    end
                    S1: begin
                        // No action needed in state S1
                    end
                    S2: begin
                        // No action needed in state S2
                    end
                    S3: begin
                        // No action needed in state S3
                    end
                    S4: begin
                        // No action needed in state S4
                    end
                    S5: begin
                        // Set MATCH to 1 when in state S5
                        MATCH <= 1'b1;
                    end
                    default: begin
                        // Default case
                    end
                endcase
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
